_schema.VIEW_NAME: string (required) - view whose global scope filter is created
_schema.VIEW_NAME_2: string (required) - second view used to check the filter applies globally
_schema.DEFAULT_SCOPE_VIEW_NAME: string (required) - view with a default scope; must be a unique view name
_schema.DRAFT_SCOPE_LEVEL: object (required) - { dimension, hierarchy, hierarchyLabel?, values[] } of the global scope filter the spec creates
_schema.DRAFT_TOGGLE_VALUE: string (required) - member of DRAFT_SCOPE_LEVEL toggled to make the default filter a draft
_schema.GRAVITEE: object (required) - Gravitee gateway overrides; only keys that differ, deep-merged over the base keys when GATEWAY_TYPE=GRAVITEE
